note: The JLPT has not published official vocabulary or kanji lists since 2010. Level assignments in Kotoba Path follow commonly used community lists.

stages.title: Orientation
stages.summary: How Japanese works: the three scripts, mora, word order, politeness.

stages.title: Hiragana
stages.summary: 46 basic characters, then dakuten, combinations, small っ and long vowels, with real words from the first row.

stages.title: Katakana
stages.summary: Same path as hiragana, plus loanwords, the long-vowel mark ー and extended combinations.

stages.title: JLPT N5
stages.summary: Kanji, vocabulary and grammar interleaved, with graded readings and listening.

stages.title: JLPT N4
stages.summary: Everyday Japanese: more kanji, て-form chains, potential and conditional forms.

stages.title: JLPT N3
stages.summary: Intermediate reading, natural-speed listening, nuance in grammar.

stages.title: JLPT N2
stages.summary: Newspapers, formal registers, keigo in practice.

stages.title: JLPT N1
stages.summary: Advanced reading and listening, literary and specialist vocabulary.
